intent: Exact, reviewed differences between the JLCEDA-exported BOM/CPL of the imported SPINC-JLC-Rev-A project and the frozen upstream JLCPCB production files. The order-package gate passes only if the measured differences equal this list; anything extra, missing or changed fails.

orderFiles.reason: JLCEDA's KiCad importer carries no LCSC part numbers into the project (all 48 exported BOM rows have empty Manufacturer/Supplier Part), and its CPL uses raw KiCad footprint origins and orientations. The frozen upstream bom.csv (44 unique LCSC parts, 91 populated designators, identical to JLC/jlc-bindings.json) and positions.csv are the designer's JLCPCB assembly files and are ordered byte-identical.

jlcOnlyPlacements.reason: Mounting holes H1/H2, an unpopulated test pad TP1 and two board-only logos exported under KiCad's placeholder reference REF** (OSHW-Symbol_6.7x6mm_SilkScreen and KiCad-Logo2_5mm_SilkScreen); none is assembled or present in the upstream CPL.

jlcBomNotInOrderBom.reason: Fiducials, mounting holes and test pad are not parts; R1 is (on_board no)(dnp yes) and TH3 is DNP in the frozen design (JLC/verify_jlc_export.py DNP_REFS).

U8.reason: Frozen schematic symbol omoteLib:DS2712 has Value 'DS2712'; the upstream production BOM names the orderable TSSOP-16 part 'DS2712E+' with LCSC C7455651, identical to JLC/jlc-bindings.json. The difference is inside the frozen design, not an import change.

deltaReason: Inference, to be confirmed in the JLCPCB assembly placement preview before payment: upstream positions.csv applies JLCPCB part-origin offsets (connector body centres) and orientation corrections (SOT-23, TSOT-23, SOT-23-5, QFN-56, TSSOP-16, bottom fiducials) that JLCEDA does not apply to KiCad-imported footprints. rotationPairs are [upstream, jlcExport] in degrees.
